name: Career switch
summary: Plan a move to a new role by mapping skill gaps, building portfolio pieces and setting weekly outreach targets.

onboarding.reaction: Thanks. That experience carries over more than you think.

onboarding.prompt: What role are you aiming for?
onboarding.reaction: Great target. Let's map the gap.

onboarding.prompt: Hours a week you can give the switch?
When would you like to be in the new role?
onboarding.reaction: Deadline set. We'll pace it out.

onboarding.prompt: Where do you feel strongest already?

onboarding.reaction: Blocks placed. This is your time.

phases.name: Map the gap
actions: Read 10 job posts for the target role
List skills you have and skills to build
Talk to 2 people in the role

phases.name: Build proof
benchmarks: Key skill course or project underway
actions: One portfolio piece every few weeks

phases.name: Reach out
benchmarks: Weekly outreach target hit most weeks

phases.name: Land and reflect
benchmarks: Offer, or a re-plan with what you learned

plan_blueprint.calendar: Weekly learning and portfolio blocks, outreach slots with follow-up reminders, and a weekly review. Phases stretch or shrink with your deadline.

approach_variants.habit: Same two blocks each week; streak of weeks with one outreach and one learning session.
approach_variants.willpower: Weekly outreach challenge and a countdown to the deadline.
approach_variants.time: Every task is a calendar block; weekly hours review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen rewards after each portfolio piece and first interview.
approach_variants.resource: First weeks gather tools: course, portfolio site, CV template, and people to ask.

guardrails: This is personal growth, kept outside any employer's tools; nothing is shared with your workplace.
This plan sets steps and targets; job outcomes depend on many things outside the plan.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
restart_rules: A missed week keeps the phase where it is and moves the timeline back a week. After three quiet weeks, the plan offers a lighter weekly target or a new deadline.

price_log.basis: Launch proposal per docs/MARKETPLACE.md; pending owner approval
